question: What café are present within 60 kilometers when moving toward Al Capone's House, Chicago, IL starting at Caldwell Woods, Chicago, IL?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.786491 41.997567)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.618785 41.762502)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.786491 41.997567)',4326)::geography, 60000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.786491 41.997567)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
